title: ABM and AI Personalization: Building the Modern ABX Stack
theme: ABM and AI Personalization: Building the Modern ABX Stack
thesis: The modern ABX stack is not about adding more tools. It is about connecting the tools you already have with an AI orchestration layer that turns buyer signals into personalized engagement at the individual level. Folloze customers see 10x engagement and 50% faster campaign builds. This guide walks you through the layers of a resilient ABX stack, the role of AI personalization, and how to avoid the fragmentation that causes AI overwhelm.
summary: You have the intent data. You have the CRM. You have the content library. But when you sit down to launch a campaign for your top 50 accounts, something breaks. The data sits in one tool. The personalization rules live in another. The content team is a week out. And your sales team is asking why the outreach still feels generic.
key_takeaways: TL;DR: The modern ABX stack is not about adding more tools.
Because buyers have changed how they research.
A modern ABX stack has four layers: account insights and targeting, personalization engine, orchestration and execution, and measurement.
proof_points: Folloze customers see 10x engagement and 50% faster campaign builds.
Folloze customers report 5x faster campaign creation using the Campaign Agent, which creates boards, ads, email, and video with brand and data controls.
Conga generated $6.3M in attributed pipeline from six campaigns built on two boards.
Microsoft saw $10M in influenced pipeline from 560 leads and 478 MQLs.
